name: starpulse-board
description: Shows the Board tasks this Claude Code session holds and every other session's status above the prompt, switches to a session through tmux on a click, and /board to list held tasks

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: nerd draws Nerd Font v3 icons (needs a Nerd Font in the terminal); plain draws ordinary Unicode characters. A terminal cannot report its font, so set plain when icons show as boxes.
